{{Top|leg}}
'''Rytar''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Rytar believed that basic staples of the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] life, such as [[shipsuit]]s and [[spacer's chest]]s, were often overlooked by fringe operators.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
